name: Mara Vale
blurb: A fictional county road surveyor who knows where the pavement changes. Holds her line until the opening is real.

look.description: Reuses Juniper Moss's existing helmet and rain-shell rider model on the existing dirt bike, with ochre and slate bike paint. No new rider art.

meta.notes: Original fictional Iowa regular for Rural Rush. A precise, low-weave racer who mostly stays out of fights; the existing rider body is a stand-in, not a newly modeled costume.
